drawings.title: Two-stage Miller-compensated OTA
drawings.description: The NMOS differential pair drives a PMOS mirror load and PMOS second stage. Cc–Rz connects n1 to vout; ibias sets the tail and output sink currents.
drawings.body_note: NFET bodies → vss; PFET bodies → vdd. Body wires are omitted using the saved cell defaults. Dimensions are in µm; R values in Ω and C values in F.

drawings.title: NMOS-input LDO with output-dependent bias
drawings.description: The error amplifier drives the PMOS pass gate G. VOUT returns through R1–R2 to FB. RB feeds the NB bias node from VOUT; C1–RZ connects G to VIN, exactly as submitted.
drawings.body_note: NFET bodies → VSS; PFET bodies → VIN. Body wires are omitted using the saved cell defaults. Dimensions are in µm; R values in Ω and C values in F.
